description: Every Sub-Stage becomes a separate item unlock. Additionally, you need to find
Stage 6-6 Unlock alongside the Lexer Fight Requirement to fight Lexer, as well
as Stage 6-8 Unlock alongside the Star Crystal to be able to fight King Hades.
Choose a Stage as a starting area.
A random Sub-Stage of the selected Stage will be chosen as the starting area when Stagesanity is enabled.
Boss Stages and Sub-Stages that can't progress without a transformation are excluded from the Sub-Stage pool.
Criteria under which Lexer becomes beatable in Stage 6-6.
You also need to find the Stage 6 Unlock item in order to access Stage 6-6.
Star Medals: Collect the required number of Star Medals to be able to fight Lexer.
Bosses: Defeat the required number of Bosses to be able to fight Lexer.
Spirits: Release the required number of Spirits to be able to fight Lexer.
Number of required Star Medals to collect when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Star Medals.
Number of required Bosses to defeat when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Bosses.
Number of required Spirits to be released when Lexer Fight Unlock is set to Spirits.
